channel.title: Rakshit Jain · Blog
channel.description: Notes on data engineering, AI agents, data quality and the web.

item.title: Your Agent Wrote the Test That Says Its Code Works
item.description: A manual audit of 1,000 AI-written unit tests found 9.6% did real work. Here's why a green suite is weak evidence when the agent wrote both sides.
item.dc:creator: Rakshit Jain

item.title: Entry-Level Data Engineering Is Not Gone. It Moved.
item.description: Junior postings are down and time-to-first-job has doubled. I went from QA intern to engineer in four months in 2026. Here's what the gap looks like up close.
item.dc:creator: Rakshit Jain

item.title: How to Prove Two Systems Hold the Same Data
item.description: Row counts match and the data is still wrong. The reconciliation ladder I use on every release: counts, aggregates, hashes, then the keys that differ.
item.dc:creator: Rakshit Jain

item.title: Will AI Replace Data Engineers? Read the Numbers First
item.description: Job postings up 80%, tech layoffs at a three-year high, and a 56% AI wage premium. The same year produced all three. Here's how to read them together.
item.dc:creator: Rakshit Jain

item.title: Agent Skills and MCP Solve Different Problems
item.description: MCP gives an agent hands. Skills give it judgement. Teams keep reaching for one when they needed the other, and the symptom looks the same either way.
item.dc:creator: Rakshit Jain

item.title: This Blog Ships Zero Markdown Parser to Your Browser
item.description: Most markdown blogs make the reader's phone do work the build server already did. Moving parsing and syntax highlighting to build time costs nothing and removes both.
item.dc:creator: Rakshit Jain

item.title: Your AI Project Will Fail on Data Quality, Not on the Model
item.description: Leading zeros destroyed by a cast. Four date formats in one column. The word null stored as text. The model is rarely the thing that went wrong.
item.dc:creator: Rakshit Jain

item.title: GTA 6 Sold $2.3 Billion in a Day. Read the Number Carefully
item.description: Every outlet printed a different GTA 6 sales figure within 24 hours of launch. None of them came from Rockstar. Here's how to tell an estimate from a fact.
item.dc:creator: Rakshit Jain

item.title: The Lakehouse Won, and the Survey Numbers Say It Is Only Half Done
item.description: Iceberg is the centre of gravity and DuckDB keeps turning up as the engine. But 44% of teams are still on a cloud warehouse, and that gap is the real story of 2026.
item.dc:creator: Rakshit Jain
